content: Papuru meta Werunawe 'Ikuniyutsie kememɨte'uyuri
Hikɨ 'Ikuniyutsie Papuru meta Werunawe mekaneutahaxɨani huriyutsixi watukita kememɨte'iyamakai, muwa mekatenikuxatakaitɨni, 'ayumieme yuri mekateniuta'erieni yumɨiretɨ huriyutsixi meta kɨriyekutsixi.
Huriyutsixi yuri memɨkate'eriekai mepɨwarukunuitɨa mepɨwahaxɨatɨakai mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixitɨkai ta'iwama wahepaɨtsita.

Mɨkɨ matsi mɨixa 'amepɨtitekai mekamamatɨ Ti'aitame hetsɨa memɨmiemetetɨkaikɨ. 'Iya katinihekɨatakaitɨni niuki 'aixɨa kemɨtiuka'iyari manuyɨne hepaɨtsita. Pɨwarupitɨaxɨa yumamakɨ 'inɨari mamariwaweme memɨteyurienikɨ.
Hikɨ kiekatari hixɨata mepɨyutsanaxɨ: hipatɨ huriyutsixi wahetsie mekateniwiyakaitɨni, hipatɨta nɨ'ariekate wahetsie mepɨtewiyakai.
Mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixitɨkai huriyutsixi wahamatɨa wa'ukiyarima wahamatɨa mekanitsutɨani 'axamewayuriekutɨ mewatuaxikutɨ.
Nɨ'ariekate yametehetimaika, mekaniyuta'una kiekaritetsie Ritsitɨratsie meta Rerɨwetsie mana hurawa Rikahuniya kwieyaritsie.
Mana mepu'uwakai niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekuxatatɨ.
Papuru Ritsitɨratsie kemɨreutituaxiexɨa
Hikɨ tewi Ritsitɨratsie pekatei nunutsiyari paitɨ ka'uyeiwetɨ mutinuiwaxɨ. Muwa kaniutikateitɨni,
Papuru tikuxatame kani'eniekaitɨni. Mɨkɨ 'ixeiyatɨ, yatimaitɨ yuri mɨti'eriekaikɨ 'aixɨa tiuyeikatɨ mayanikɨ,
karima mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kenanukukexi, 'a'ɨkate keneutixutsera. Mɨkɨ kaniutitsuna, kuyeikatɨ kanayani.
Teɨteri me'ixeiyaka Papuru kemɨtiuyuri, me'utihiwatɨ rikahuniyatari waniukikɨ, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Kakaɨyarixi tahetsɨa mepu'axɨa teɨteri wahepaɨ meteyuxexeiyatɨ.
Werunawe Tsehuxi mepute'uterɨwaxɨ, meta Papuru 'Eximetsi mɨkɨmeri niuki mukuxatakaikɨ.
Kupiteri tukieya kiekari 'aurie manuwe, mawari wewiwameya turutsixi kaniwa'atɨani wa'awate xuturiyatɨkaime kitenietsie kaniuku'uitɨani. Teɨteri yumɨireme wahɨxie, mɨkɨ mawari kaniwaweriemɨkɨkaitɨni.
Me'u'enanaka nɨ'ariekate Werunawe meta Papuru, yu'ixuriki metitsanatɨ me'unautsaxɨaximetɨ mekaniu'axɨani teɨteri wahetsɨa me'utihiwatɨ, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ:

—Xeme teɨteri 'aku ¿titayari mɨpaɨ xeteyurie? Tame xehepaɨ tekaniteɨteritɨni, xehepaɨ tekateniu'iyarini. Niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne temɨxekuxaxatɨwa xemɨtehayewakɨ yakɨ xeikɨa xemɨteyurie, Kakaɨyari mayeyuritsie xemɨtewiyanikɨ. Mɨkɨ muyuawi, kwie meta haramara putiwewi, meta naime wahetsie memɨtexuawetɨka.
Meripaitɨ xeteɨterima mepɨwarupitɨa nuiwarite yuhuye memanukuweiyakɨ.
Tsiere pɨkayuhayewakai kaheixeiyatɨ kemɨ'ane mitahekɨatake. 'Aixɨa katiniyurienekaitɨni, wiyeri muyuawitsie mieme pɨtatsipitɨakai, meta 'ikwaxi puxuaweriyakai. Xe'iyari muyutemawiekakɨ xetekwakaku.
Mɨpaɨ me'utiyuaka hawerimiemete xeikɨa mekaniwarukunuitɨani, teɨteri mawari memɨkawawewirienikɨ.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi mana mekaniu'axɨani 'Anutiyukiyatsie meta 'Ikuniyutsie meheyekɨneka. Teɨteri mekaniwarukunuitɨani. Papuru mekaniutituaxixɨani. Mekaneihana kiekari tetsie mɨkime me'erietɨ.
Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete 'auriena mehaketɨkɨneku, kananukukeni. Kiekaritsie kaneyani. 'Uxa'ariekata Werunawe hamatɨa Rerɨwe mekanekɨne.
'Anutiyukiya Tsiriya kwieyaritsie kememɨte'u'axɨa
Mana niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekaniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni kiekatari, yuwaɨkawame mekateniwa'ɨkitɨakaitɨni. 'Ariketa me'akunuaxɨaka, Ritsitɨratsie, 'Ikuniyutsie meta 'Anutiyukiyatsie meniuyekɨne.

Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wa'iyari mekaniutuikaxɨani metewakuxaxatɨwatɨ para yuri mete'erietɨ memɨyuhayewanikɨ, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Peuyewetse waɨkawa te'uximatɨarieme temeutahaxɨanikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨra'aitatsie».
Naitsarie memɨyutixexeɨriwatsie wa'ukiyarima mekananayexeiyarieni. Meyutanenewieka me'uyuhakieka mepihɨritɨa Ti'aitame, mɨkɨ yuri memɨte'uta'erikɨ hetsiena.
Hikɨ Pitsiriya kwieyaritsie me'uyekɨneka, Pamɨpiriya kwieyaritsie paitɨ mekaniu'axɨani.
Mete'utahayewaka niuki me'utaxataka Perɨketsie, 'Atahariyatsie mekaneukayune.
Mana kanuwa 'amɨpatsie mekanekɨne 'Anutiyukiyatsie paitɨ hakewa memayenɨ'arie Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyarinikɨ wahetsiemieme, memɨte'uximayakakɨ kememɨteheye'atɨa.
Me'u'axɨaka mekaniwarukuxeɨrieni memɨyutixexeɨriwa. Mekateniwarutaxatɨani kehepaɨ mɨreyuriekai Kakaɨyari wahamatɨa 'uyeikatɨ, mɨpaɨta yuri mekateneta'erieni nuiwarite memɨkahuriyutsixi.
Mɨkɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahetsɨa mɨixa tukari mana mekaneyuhayewa.
